title: ModForge plugin spec
description: Describes the content of one Skyrim plugin. See docs/SPEC.md. Property names are matched case-insensitively by the generator.
$comment: In a spec DATA file, an object { "$ref": ... } or { "$env": ... } is a ModForge preprocessor directive (see docs/SPEC-refs.md) — $ref splices JSON from a file / file#pointer / same-doc pointer, $env substitutes an environment variable. They are resolved BEFORE deserialization, may appear in place of any value, and never reach the record builder, so this schema does not (and cannot) validate them. This is unrelated to the JSON-Schema $ref used internally within this schema document.

banter.description: Banter: proactive UNPROMPTED NPC lines (the follower-comment pattern); entries sharing a (speaker,quest) become one Random-pick ambient IDLE topic

scenes.description: Scene (SCEN): two+ NPCs talking to EACH OTHER (not the player), hosted by a quest, played as ordered phases; supports presence-gated autoStart + non-dialog (package/timer) beats

relationships.description: Relationship (RELA): a directed NPC_-to-NPC_ bond at a rank; child defaults to the player NPC base 0x000014

combatStyles.description: CombatStyle (CSTY): HOW an NPC fights; reference via npc.combatStyle

packages.description: AI Package (PACK); assign via npc.packages. See SPEC.md for the template-input subobjects

npcPatches.description: override an EXISTING vanilla/other-master NPC and swap its AI package list (AI Overhaul style). Needs the master (MODFORGE_SKYRIM_DATA); the override carries the NPC's real English name inline.

overrideOf.description: the existing NPC ref '<master>:0xFORMID' (e.g. Skyrim.esm:0x013B99 = Carlotta Valentia)

packages.description: PACK refs (in-spec editorId or vanilla '<master>:0xFORMID') forming the new schedule

mode.description: replace = use ONLY our packages; prepend/append = keep the NPC's existing packages and add ours before/after (default replace)

magicEffects.description: custom MGEF records an effect can point at by editorId

projectiles.description: Projectile (PROJ): the flying bolt of an Aimed spell; a magicEffect.projectile ref points here

explosions.description: Explosion (EXPL): the impact AoE a projectile/spell triggers; a magicEffect.explosion or projectile.explosion ref points here

hazards.description: Hazard (HAZD): a radius effect applying a spell to actors in it; spell-spawned (MGEF archetype SpawnHazard) or placed (PlacedHazard)

musicTracks.description: Music Track (MUST): an audio entry (SingleTrack/Palette/SilentTrack) referenced by a music (MUSC)

music.description: Music Type (MUSC): a container assigned to cells[].music / worldspaces[].music

imageSpaceModifiers.description: ImageSpaceModifier (IMAD): a screen-space post-process (brightness/tint) applied at runtime; referenced by explosion.imageSpaceModifier or a Papyrus property

factions.description: Faction (FACT); add a `vendor` sub-object to make members shopkeepers

classes.description: Class (CLAS): an npc 'profession' (attribute/skill weights); an npc class can point at one

placements.description: put a base form into a cell at a position/rotation

mapMarkers.description: permanent world-map markers (XMRK on the MapMarker static)

leveledNpcs.description: LeveledNpc (LVLN): level-gated weighted npc lists (also a placement `base` for a leveled-actor spawn)

formLists.description: FormList (FLST): an ordered list of FormIDs of any type; use as a list-taking condition's param (GetItemCount/GetEquipped/GetIsVoiceType/GetInWorldspace), a keyword/clothing set, etc.

items.description: refs (in-spec editorId or vanilla <master>:0xFORMID), any record type; order preserved

encounterZones.description: EncounterZone (ECZN): level scaling / respawn for an area; a cell/spawn `encounterZone` points at one

containers.description: Container (CONT): a named container with item contents

scrolls.description: Scroll (SCRL): one-shot spell-as-item with effects + cast fields

keywords.description: Keyword (KYWD): define your own so in-spec records can reference it

outfits.description: Outfit (OTFT): a set of item refs an NPC can wear

furniture.description: Furniture (FURN): a placeable interactive object (chair/bed/bench), vanilla or custom mesh

sounds.description: SoundDescriptor (SNDR): wraps a user .wav/.xwm so records can FormLink to it

assets.description: External-resource source dir; package copies its Meshes/Textures/Sounds/Music/Seq sub-trees next to the .esp. See docs/external_assets.md

textureSets.description: TextureSet (TXST): retexture an existing mesh without a new .nif

enchantments.description: Enchantment / Object Effect (ENCH): MGEF-based effects bundled into a weapon/staff/apparel enchantment a weapon/armor references via its `enchantment` field

lights.description: Light (LIGT): a custom light source (colour/radius/flicker); place it via placements[] by editorId

lightingTemplates.description: LightingTemplate (LGTM): reusable interior lighting (ambient/directional/fog + DALC hemisphere). Author by copying a vanilla LGTM via `template` then overriding fields. CELLs reference it via cells[].lightingTemplate

imageSpaces.description: ImageSpace (IMGS): screen-space HDR/cinematic/tint attached to a CELL. Copy a vanilla IMGS via `template` then bump brightness/saturation etc. CELLs reference it via cells[].imageSpace

weathers.description: Weather (WTHR): a custom sky (cloud layers, per-time-of-day colours, precipitation, wind, fog)

climates.description: Climate (CLMT): a weather cycle + sunrise/sunset timing + sun/moon textures; references weathers

worldspaces.description: Worldspace (WRLD): a new exterior world (climate/water/parent/map). RECORD LAYER ONLY — terrain/LOD/navmesh stay CK-side.

regions.description: Region (REGN): an area inside a worldspace + its weather table (the climate hook).

perks.description: Perk (PERK): a passive ability / stat-or-combat modifier; attach to an NPC via npc.perks

wordsOfPower.description: WordOfPower (WOOP): one dragon-language syllable; referenced by a shout's words[].word + a word wall's word

shouts.description: Shout (SHOU): a dragon shout = up to 3 words, each a WOOP + a Voice SPEL. Unusable until learned at a word wall

wordWalls.description: The learnable layer: a teaching quest + generated Papyrus fragment + WordWallTrigger placement that teaches a shout's word

globals.description: GlobalVariable (GLOB): a named number shared game-wide, save-persisted, readable by conditions (GetGlobalValue) + Papyrus. `value` is the INITIAL value only (existing saves keep their runtime value)

identities.description: Lightweight identity/class system: each identity is a FACT (held signal) + priority + optional grants/acquire. Gate dialogue with identity/primaryIdentity; acquire via a book's OnRead.

presets.description: Non-emitting cookbook catalog. Named fragments under lighting/weather/packages/identities are ignored by build; copy or expand them into the normal top-level arrays to emit records.

voiceSpeakers.description: bind an EXTERNAL dialogue speaker (an NPC from another master the mod-only cache can't resolve, e.g. an existing follower) to a voiceType + voiceTemplate, so voicelines/voicediag can voice lines gated on GetIsID(<that NPC>)

speaker.description: the NPC ref the line's GetIsID gates on (<master>:0xFORMID)

voiceType.description: that NPC's voiceType (the Sound/Voice/<plugin>/ folder name, e.g. JJSofiaVoiceType)

template.description: a voiceTemplates[] id to generate the lines with

animationReplacers.description: OAR (Open Animation Replacer) replacer/moveset folders generated as LOOSE FILES (no esp). Each is a replacer-mod with named submods; .hkx animations are user-supplied. See docs/spec/SPEC-animation.md.

behaviorData.description: Behavior Data Injector (BDI) configs: inject graph variables/events into a behavior project with no behavior patch. Emitted to SKSE/Plugins/BehaviorDataInjector/<file>.json.

payloadMacros.description: Payload Interpreter (PIE) macro tables: named macros -> payload commands. Emitted to SKSE/PayloadInterpreter/Config/<file>.ini.

ref.description: A reference: an in-spec editorId OR an external form '<master>:0xFORMID' (e.g. 'Skyrim.esm:0x013746' = NordRace). Discover FormIDs with the `find` command.

presetCatalog.description: Named cookbook fragments grouped by existing spec family. This is documentation/data only: the generator does not emit records from presets directly.

lighting.description: Interior lighting fragments, usually lightingTemplates/imageSpaces/lights/cell fields.

packages.description: AI package fragments using existing PackageSpec shapes.

identities.description: Identity fragments using existing IdentitySpec plus optional books/perks/spells.

presetFragment.description: A named cookbook fragment. `_` may describe intent; other properties mirror existing top-level spec arrays.

magicEffect.description: MagicEffect ref — a vanilla one (e.g. 'Skyrim.esm:0x03EB15' = AlchRestoreHealth; find <Skyrim.esm> <query> MagicEffect) OR an in-spec magicEffects entry's editorId

damage.description: base damage; functional weapon needs this > 0

speed.description: swing speed (~1.0 normal); defaults to 1.0 if any stat is set

reach.description: reach (~1.0 normal); defaults to 1.0 if any stat is set

enchantment.description: ENCH ref — an in-spec enchantments entry or a vanilla ObjectEffect (<master>:0xFORMID)

enchantmentAmount.description: the weapon's charge pool (casts before recharge); e.g. 1500-3000; 0 = engine auto-calc

template.description: vanilla weapon to clone for model/animation/sounds (<master>:0xFORMID). A bare WEAP with no template + no model equips INVISIBLE. Cloning also keeps the template's stats for any field left at 0 (e.g. leave `damage` 0 to inherit)

model.description: optional .nif path (rooted at Meshes\, omit the prefix); overrides the cloned template's model

pickUpSound.description: SNDR ref played when picked up

enchantType.description: weapon = cast-on-strike (charge); apparel = constant-effect (always-on while worn); staff = staff cast-on-use (charge)

effects.description: magic effects (does nothing without at least one)

equipType.description: EQUP ref — which slot the spell occupies. Castable types (Spell/Voice/Power/LesserPower) default to EitherHand (Skyrim.esm:0x013F44) when omitted; set only to override (BothHands/Left/RightHand). A hand spell with no EQUP can't be equipped; a shout word-spell needs one or the player can't shout it

magicEffect.description: a custom MGEF; reference it from an effect's magicEffect by editorId

archetype.description: what the effect does; ValueModifier is the common damage/heal/fortify

actorValue.description: the actor value it acts on, e.g. Health, Magicka, Stamina, MagickaRate

secondActorValue.description: DualValueModifier archetype only: a 2nd affected actor value (e.g. Magicka)

secondActorValueWeight.description: DualValueModifier archetype only: how the magnitude splits to the 2nd AV (0 = all to primary)

resistValue.description: actor value that resists it, e.g. ResistFire, ResistFrost, PoisonResist (or None)

flags.description: instant restore/damage: [NoDuration,NoArea] (+Hostile,Detrimental for damage); timed fortify: [Recover]. Recover on an instant effect cancels it.

association.description: summoned/bound form ref (only for Summon/Bound-type archetypes)

projectile.description: PROJ ref — the bolt that travels; needed for an Aimed spell to be visible (e.g. Skyrim.esm:0x10FBEA)

castingArt.description: ARTO ref — FX at the caster's hands (e.g. Skyrim.esm:0x01B211)

hitEffectArt.description: ARTO ref — FX at the impact point

explosion.description: EXPL ref — AoE explosion on impact

sounds.description: MGEF sound descriptors; Release = the Thuum voice the player yells for a shout

effects.description: magic effects (a potion is fully functional with one)

template.description: vanilla ALCH to clone a model from (<master>:0xFORMID)

keywords.description: keyword refs (weapons/misc; ignored on records that don't take keywords)

template.description: (miscItems) vanilla MISC to clone a model from (<master>:0xFORMID)

model.description: (miscItems) .nif path (rooted at Meshes\, omit the prefix)

pickUpSound.description: (miscItems) SNDR ref played when picked up

vendor.description: Vendor data (FACT VENV/VEND/VENC). Present => Vendor-flagged merchant faction; members are shopkeepers and the generic 'I'd like to trade' topic surfaces.

sellBuyList.description: FormList of VendorItem keywords (e.g. Skyrim.esm:0x06CB48 VendorItemsMisc)

notSellBuyList.description: true => sellBuyList is a NOT-sell list (trade everything except)

merchantContainer.description: a PLACEMENT editorId: the placed merchant chest (gold + stock)

template.description: ref to a vanilla BOOK to clone a model from; a takeable/readable book needs one or it CRASHES on read

teaches.description: a teaching book: a spell tome (grants a SPEL) or a skill book (raises a Skill) on first read

spell.description: ref to a SPEL (in-spec editorId or <master>:0xFORMID); when kind=spell

slots.description: biped slots occupied, e.g. Body, Head, Hands, Feet, Forearms, Calves, Shield (BipedObjectFlag names)

enchantment.description: ENCH ref — normally an in-spec apparel (constant-effect) enchantments entry, or a vanilla ObjectEffect (<master>:0xFORMID)

template.description: vanilla armor to clone for its Armature (worn mesh) + WorldModel + BodyTemplate (<master>:0xFORMID, e.g. Skyrim.esm:0x00012E49 ArmorIronCuirass). REQUIRED for the armor to be visible when equipped — a bare ARMO equips INVISIBLE.

model.description: optional ground/world model .nif path; overrides the cloned template's. The worn mesh still comes from the template's Armature, so pair `model` with a `template`.

teaches.description: a Skill the class can train (trainer NPCs)

race.description: Race ref; needed (with class) for a functional actor

level.description: fixed level (0 = default); needed for class-based stat auto-calc

autoCalcStats.description: derive H/M/S + skills from level + class (else flat 50/50/50 defaults)

packages.description: PACK refs; the NPC's AI package list, evaluated in order

voiceType.description: VTYP ref (e.g. MaleNord Skyrim.esm:0x013AE6); without one the NPC is silent

voiceTemplate.description: ref → voiceTemplates ID; routes this NPC's lines to a cloning engine

crimeFaction.description: FACT ref; city-citizen identity, required for cross-cell Travel

unique.description: one-off actor (vs leveled); helps engine AI tracking + cross-cell travel

combatStyle.description: CSTY ref; HOW the AI fights (magic/melee/ranged preference)

spells.description: SPEL refs; the AI's spell list

perks.description: PERK refs granted to the actor as passive ability/entry-point perks at game start

greeting.description: Hello line; when this NPC has custom dialogue, a Hello info is auto-emitted so it is conversable. Empty => default line

essential.description: cannot be killed (drops to bleedout then recovers) — for a non-lethal brawl or plot-critical NPC. NOTE: an essential NPC also CANNOT be looted; use `protected` instead if the player should be able to loot custom gear

protected.description: can only be killed by the PLAYER (other NPCs can't land the killing blow); lootable, unlike essential

items.description: inventory the NPC carries — a weapon/armor here is auto-equipped if it's the NPC's best (how you arm an NPC); loot drops on death. A 0-damage weapon scores below fists and won't be drawn

parent.description: NPC_ base ref (the relationship owner; usually the custom NPC)

child.description: NPC_ base ref; defaults to the Player NPC base Skyrim.esm:0x000014. NOTE: must be an NPC_, NOT PlayerRef 0x000007 (an ACHR) — that CRASHES on load

rank.description: Ally satisfies the vanilla free-follow gate

equipMultMagic.description: raise well above the others to make the AI prefer spells

encounterZone.description: EncounterZone (ECZN): level scaling + respawn for an area; a cell/spawn `encounterZone` points at one

minLevel.description: floor of the spawn level range

maxLevel.description: cap of the spawn level range; 0 = UNCAPPED (scales with the player — the vanilla dungeon idiom)

flags.description: NeverResets = no respawn; MatchPcBelowMinimumLevel = below-min players get player-level spawns; DisableCombatBoundary = actors may chase out of the zone

template.description: vanilla procedure template, e.g. Sandbox=Skyrim.esm:0x01C254, Travel=Skyrim.esm:0x016FAA

schedule.description: { month, dayOfWeek, date, hour, minute, durationInMinutes }

sandbox.description: Sandbox template inputs (radius, allowEating, ...); see SPEC.md

useMagic.description: UseMagic template inputs (spell, numToCastMax, ...); see SPEC.md

sitTarget.description: SitTarget template (Skyrim.esm:0x0A9277) inputs: target (REQUIRED furniture ref), waitTime, stopMovement — NPC walks to and sits on the furniture; see SPEC-packages.md

activate.description: Activate template inputs (target [required], numberToActivate); see SPEC.md

eat.description: Eat template inputs (location, radius, allowSitting, ...); see SPEC.md

startGameEnabled.description: auto-start on load (default true; required for hosted dialogue)

type.description: Quest TYPE (DNAM) — which journal tab it groups under. type=None = a background/controller quest that does NOT appear in the journal (its stage log entries never show). Leave empty for the smart default: a quest with journal content -> SideQuest; a pure dialogue/controller quest -> None

showStage.description: stage index that displays this objective (-1 = none)

completeStage.description: stage index that completes this objective (-1 = none)

targets.description: QSTA compass/map markers; the arrow follows the named alias's fill

alias.description: alias NAME on the same quest

stages.description: quest milestones; index unique + ascending. See SPEC.md 'quest stages'.

logEntry.description: journal text shown when the quest reaches this stage

completeQuest.description: close the quest at this stage

failQuest.description: fail the quest at this stage

startUpStage.description: engine auto-runs SetStage to this stage on quest start (QSDT Start Up Stage flag) — how an SM-triggered quest shows its opening log entry/objective with no external SetStage. At most one per quest.

conditions.description: optional CTDA gate on the log entry (e.g. function GetStage, param the quest ref)

storyEvent.description: Story Manager trigger: this quest starts when the named event fires. Build auto-sets startGameEnabled=false and wires the SM tree.

event.description: Event name: KillActor | ChangeLocation | CastMagic | AddItem | Assault | CraftItem | PlayerRemoveItem | Arrest | IncreaseLevel | ScriptEvent

conditions.description: CTDA gates on the SM branch (e.g. GetIsID victim)

keyword.description: ScriptEvent only: editorId of a KYWD declared in spec.keywords; the dispatcher passes it to SendStoryEvent and the branch filters on it

aliases.description: Quest aliases filled by the SM event or forced refs.

name.description: alias name (must be unique within the quest)

fill.description: fromEvent:<slot> (R1/R2/L1/L2) | forced:<ref> | uniqueActor:<ref> | createObject:<ref>@<targetAlias> (spawn a new ref AT another ref-type alias) | findMatching:closest|any (nearest/first existing ref in the loaded area matching this alias's conditions)

optional.description: quest still starts even if this alias cannot be filled

allowReserved.description: allow filling with a ref held by another running quest (uniqueActor forces this on)

conditions.description: findMatching only (required): CTDA filter on WHICH loaded-area ref the engine picks (e.g. HasKeyword ActorTypeNPC = nearest NPC)

script.description: optional alias script Scriptname (extends ReferenceAlias) attached to this alias's VMAD — reacts to events on whatever ref fills it (e.g. OnActivate on a createObject-spawned ref to chain a story event via MFStoryEventDispatch.Fire)

scriptSource.description: the alias script's .psc, compiled by `package` (you supply/ship the .pex)

scriptProperties.description: typed Auto properties bound on the alias-script VMAD (e.g. a Keyword for a dispatcher trigger)

questEditorId.description: must be a quest editorId in this spec

speakerNpcEditorId.description: optional; an npc editorId (GetIsID condition). The speaker also needs a `greeting` so it is conversable

emotion.description: applied to all response lines (default Neutral)

setStage.description: advance the host quest to this stage when the line is picked (-1 = none); needs the generated TIF fragment compiled in CK

openBarter.description: open the BARTER/trade menu with the speaking NPC when picked (vanilla Actor.ShowBarterMenu(), no SKSE); speaker must be a vendor-faction member with a merchant chest; pair with an identity gate for a merchant-only trade option

setGlobal.description: write or adjust one GlobalVariable when the line is picked. Use value for flags/absolute reputation states (SetValue) or delta for counters (Mod). The GLOB can then gate dialogue/identity.activeWhen via GetGlobalValue.

value.description: absolute value to write with SetValue

delta.description: relative counter change to apply with GlobalVariable.Mod; positive increments, negative decrements

rewardItem.description: give the player this item/gold when the line is picked (Game.GetPlayer().AddItem); use with setStage for a quest reward

rewardCount.description: how many of rewardItem to give (default 1)

evaluateSpeakerPackages.description: force the speaking NPC to re-evaluate AI packages (Actor.EvaluatePackage()) so a package newly enabled by this line's setStage (e.g. a follow package gated on GetStage==N) activates immediately

resultScript.description: custom result-script Scriptname (extends TopicInfo) wired as the line's OnBegin Fragment_0; overrides the auto setStage TIF

resultScriptSource.description: optional .psc path (rel. to spec) for resultScript; `package` compiles it (beside the embedded dispatcher header for Fire()-routed triggers)

resultProperties.description: typed properties bound on the result-script VMAD (e.g. a Keyword for a dispatcher trigger)

goodbye.description: close the dialogue menu after this line (vanilla recruit/dismiss lines set it)

sayOnce.description: INFO (ENAM) flag: speak this line at most once ever (VIGILANT's most-used flag — one-shot story beats)

walkAway.description: INFO (ENAM) flag: the NPC walks off after delivering this line

random.description: INFO (ENAM) flag: the engine random-picks among sibling INFOs whose conditions pass (line variety)

invisibleContinue.description: INFO (ENAM) flag: immediately continue to the next INFO in the chain without closing the menu

forceSubtitle.description: INFO (ENAM) flag: always show the subtitle even when subtitles are off

topLevel.description: dialogue tree: false = a SUB-topic that only appears when another line linkTo's it (default true = a normal top-level option)

linkTo.description: dialogue tree (ENAM): after this line, surface these dialogue topics as the next choices — each is another dialogue's editorId or a vanilla <master>:0xFORMID topic

previousDialog.description: dialogue tree (PNAM): chain this INFO after another (a dialogue editorId or <master>:0xFORMID INFO)

hello.description: emit this line as the NPC's auto-spoken GREETING (Misc/Hello) instead of a player menu option; combine with identity/primaryIdentity/conditions to greet differently by state (engine picks the highest-priority matching Hello, else the NPC's plain greeting). prompt is ignored.

identity.description: gate this line on the player HOLDING this identity (identities[].id) — expands to GetInFaction>=1 (+ the identity's activeWhen)

primaryIdentity.description: gate this line on this identity being the player's CURRENT PRIMARY (the controller-maintained MF_PrimaryIdentity global == its code) — used for state-varying greetings

setPrimaryIdentity.description: when the player picks this topic, manually OVERRIDE the primary identity to this id (or 'auto' to clear) — generates a TIF fragment setting MF_IdentityOverride; pair with an identity gate

conditions.description: extra CTDA gates on the INFO beyond the auto GetIsID speaker gate (e.g. only show a paid recruit line when the player can afford it)

source.description: optional .psc path (rel. to spec); `package` compiles it

template.description: optional vanilla INTERIOR cell '<master>:0xFORMID' to copy lighting/water env from (a new cell with no lighting renders BLACK; find one with `find <Skyrim.esm> <name> Cell`). Still place a floor static via a `placement`, else the player falls into the void.

encounterZone.description: optional ECZN ref (in-spec editorId or '<master>:0xFORMID') — the whole cell's level scaling / respawn (XEZN)

lightingTemplate.description: optional LGTM ref: an in-spec lightingTemplates entry editorId OR a vanilla '<master>:0xFORMID' (e.g. Skyrim.esm:0x0300E2 = DefaultLightingTemplate). Controls ambient/directional/fog/DALC for the cell.

imageSpace.description: optional IMGS ref: an in-spec imageSpaces entry editorId OR a vanilla '<master>:0xFORMID'. Controls HDR eye-adapt / bloom / cinematic look for the cell.

music.description: optional MUSC ref: an in-spec music[] entry editorId OR a vanilla '<master>:0xFORMID'. The music type that plays in this cell.

lighting.description: optional inline XCLL overrides; fields left null are pulled from the lightingTemplate. Use when you need per-cell tweaks on top of the shared template.

placement.description: set EITHER `cell` (interior) OR `worldspace` (exterior); worldspace wins if both are set

base.description: the form to place: an in-spec npc/object editorId or external <master>:0xFORMID. May also be a LeveledNpc (LVLN) list for a LEVELED-ACTOR SPAWN — the ACHR then rolls a level-appropriate actor (add kind:"npc" for a vanilla list). MARKERS: XMarker = Skyrim.esm:0x00003B, XMarkerHeading = Skyrim.esm:0x000034 (a Travel/Patrol/scene anchor). DOORS: a load-door base (e.g. FarmhouseLDoor01 = Skyrim.esm:0x029CB0) + `teleport` makes a walk-through link

editorId.description: optional: names this REFR/ACHR so other refs can target it (patrol start, linkedRefs target, teleport partner). Must be unique

cell.description: INTERIOR target: an in-spec cell editorId OR a vanilla INTERIOR cell '<master>:0xFORMID' (find with `find <Skyrim.esm> <name> Cell`)

worldspace.description: EXTERIOR target: a worldspace '<master>:0xFORMID' (Tamriel = Skyrim.esm:0x00003C; find with `find <Skyrim.esm> <name> Worldspace`). `position` is then WORLD coords; the cell at floor(x/4096),floor(y/4096) is overridden

kind.description: inferred for in-spec bases; defaults to object for external. xmarker/xmarkerHeading default an empty base to the vanilla marker static + force persistent

position.description: cell-local for interior; WORLD coords for exterior

persistent.description: place in the cell's persistent (vs temporary) list (teleport doors / linkedRefs sources / package anchors are forced persistent automatically)

encounterZone.description: optional ECZN ref — a per-ref override of the cell's zone (this spawn's XEZN); usually only meaningful on a leveled-actor spawn

teleport.description: LOAD-DOOR pair: the PARTNER door this door teleports to (a placement editorId, or a vanilla door '<master>:0xFORMID'). Set on BOTH doors (each pointing at the other). `base` must be a DOOR. Arrival = the partner's position/rotation (written to this door's XTEL)

linkedRefs.description: Linked References (XLKR) on this ref — the Patrol route chain etc. Source placement must have an editorId

target.description: the linked placed ref (a placement editorId or external ref)

keyword.description: optional KYWD tagging the link; empty = the null/default link a Patrol route follows

reference.description: the item (LVLI) or npc (LVLN) to spawn — in-spec or external

level.description: min player/encounter level for this entry (default 1)

chanceNone.description: percent chance the list yields nothing

item.description: the item to put inside — in-spec or external

kind.description: recipe flavour; picks the default bench (craft->forge, temper->sharpening wheel, smelt/breakdown->smelter)

createdObject.description: the item produced (temper: the item being improved) — usually an in-spec weapon/armor/etc.

workbench.description: named selector (forge|sharpeningWheel|armorTable|smelter|tanningRack|skyforge) OR a keyword ref; omit -> the kind default

components.description: ingredients consumed on craft (item ref + count)

function.description: the CTDA function; HasPerk/GetItemCount/GetGlobalValue need a param, TemperIsEnchanted does not

or.description: OR-chain with the NEXT condition (default AND)

editorId.description: reference it from any record's `keywords` list

items.description: armor/weapon refs the NPC wears; an npc `outfit` can point at this editorId

model.description: a .nif path, Data-relative rooted at Meshes\ (omit the 'Meshes\' prefix), vanilla OR custom, e.g. 'Clutter\\Common\\Rock01.nif' or 'MyMod\\stone.nif'

alternateTextures.description: retexture named materials of `model` via TXST records

model.description: a .nif path (rooted at Meshes\, omit the prefix)

alternateTextures.description: retexture named materials of `model` via TXST records

activationSound.description: SNDR ref (in-spec sounds editorId or vanilla <master>:0xFORMID) played on activation

loopingSound.description: SNDR ref played in a loop while present

model.description: a .nif path (rooted at Meshes\, omit the prefix), vanilla OR custom

files.description: Data-relative Sound\... paths to .wav/.xwm audio (the package step bundles them)

outputModel.description: SOPM ref; empty -> Skyrim.esm:0x0B4058 vanilla SFX output

textureSet.description: TextureSet (TXST): retexture an existing mesh without a new .nif. All slot paths are RELATIVE to Data\Textures\ (omit the leading 'Textures\') and end in .dds. Wire it via a record's alternateTextures.

alternateTexture.description: Override one named material/sub-mesh of a base .nif with a TXST.

color.description: An 8-bit RGB(A) colour; components 0–255 (alpha usually 0 for weather colours).

weatherColor.description: A weather colour across times of day; omitted ones fall back to `day`.

weather.description: A custom sky (WTHR). Minimal = just editorId (clear-day baseline).

template.description: optional vanilla weather to DeepCopy as base (e.g. Skyrim.esm:0x10E1F2 = SkyrimClear_A); inherited clouds/colours are kept unless overridden

imageSpaces.description: Per-time-of-day ImageSpace (IMGS) for outdoor color grading (HDR/bloom/saturation). Each value is an in-spec imageSpaces editorId or vanilla '<master>:0xFORMID'. `default` fills any time-of-day left empty.

weatherImageSpaces.description: Per-time-of-day IMGS refs for a weather record. `default` fills any unset time-of-day slot.

default.description: IMGS ref used for any time-of-day not explicitly set; in-spec editorId or '<master>:0xFORMID'

sunrise.description: IMGS ref for sunrise; in-spec editorId or '<master>:0xFORMID'

day.description: IMGS ref for day; in-spec editorId or '<master>:0xFORMID'

sunset.description: IMGS ref for sunset; in-spec editorId or '<master>:0xFORMID'

night.description: IMGS ref for night; in-spec editorId or '<master>:0xFORMID'

climate.description: A weather cycle (CLMT). Minimal = editorId + at least one weather.
CLMT ref — the sky/lighting cycle (strongly advised; without it the world has no day/night)

lodWater.description: WATR ref for distant LOD water (optional)

defaultLandHeight.description: WRLD land default (Tamriel -27000); leave it unless you know better

defaultWaterHeight.description: WRLD water default (Tamriel -14000); a 0 here floods sub-0 terrain

cells.description: Flat terrain cells (CELL+LAND) to generate inside this worldspace. Enter in-game with: cow <editorId> X Y

worldspace.description: the WRLD this region lives in (in-spec or vanilla)

edgeFallOff.description: blend distance (units) at the region border

weather.description: the weather table — >=1 entry, chances must sum > 0 (the climate hook)

area.description: polygon of >=3 world-space points enclosing the area

worldspaceCell.description: A flat terrain cell (CELL+LAND) at exterior grid coordinates (X,Y). 1 unit = 4096 game units; (0,0) is origin.

height.description: terrain height in game units (default 4000 ≈ 280 m above sea level; 0 = sea level)

navmesh.description: generate a flat 4-vertex quad NAVM covering the full cell so NPCs can path on it (no cross-cell links)

mapMarker.description: A permanent world-map marker (XMRK on the MapMarker static). Also usable as an objective target via a forced: alias.

condition.description: A CTDA condition (the shared ConditionSpec). function is a supported condition-function name; comparison + value are the test; param/actorValue/itemType supply the function's parameter; runOn picks Subject/Target; or ORs with the next.

actorValue.description: ActorValue param for GetBaseActorValue/GetActorValue (e.g. OneHanded, Destruction)

alias.description: for GetIsAliasRef: an alias NAME on the owning quest (dialogue/banter/scene/stage/objective only) — resolved to its alias index

stage.description: for GetStageDone: the stage INDEX to test (a parameter, distinct from the comparison value)

scene.description: for IsSceneActionComplete: the scene whose action is tested (a scene editorId ref; omit on a scene condition to default to the owning scene)

sceneActionIndex.description: for IsSceneActionComplete: the action's index in the built SCEN (inspect with scenediag)

reference.description: the ref read when runOn=Reference (e.g. the player Skyrim.esm:0x000014)

perkEffect.description: One perk effect. kind=ability grants spell; kind=entryPoint modifies a named EntryPoint (entryPoint name + function + value).

entryPoint.description: (entryPoint) EntryType name, e.g. ModAttackDamage. List all: perkdiag <Skyrim.esm> entrypoints

value.description: (entryPoint) the operand, e.g. 1.2 for +20% with Multiply

nextPerk.description: optional ref to the next perk in a rank chain

name.description: dragon-script glyph shown in the shout menu

spell.description: SPEL ref — a Voice-type spell fired at this charge level

editorId.description: editorId of the generated teaching quest

wordIndex.description: which of the shout's 3 words to teach

word.description: explicit WOOP ref; auto-derived from an in-spec shout's wordIndex, required for a vanilla shout

triggerBase.description: ACTI base to place; defaults to vanilla WordWallTrigger Skyrim.esm:0x05095E

worldspace.description: exterior worldspace ref; position is world-space

npcItem.description: One inventory entry on an NPC: a carriable item ref + count.

item.description: ref → a carriable item (weapon/armor/misc/potion/ammo/gold). Gold001 = Skyrim.esm:0x00000F

count.description: stack count (default 1; use larger counts for gold/arrows/potions; must be != 0)

banter.description: A proactive unprompted NPC line (ambient IDLE topic). Only surfaces while the NPC has idle chatter (an AI package with the AllowIdleChatter interrupt flag). Use conditions to make it situational.

editorId.description: optional — names the INFO group for diag/uniqueness

questEditorId.description: host quest editorId (must be StartGameEnabled, like dialogue)

speakerNpcEditorId.description: who says it (auto GetIsID gate); an npc editorId

responses.description: the spoken line(s) for this one comment (played in sequence)

conditions.description: situational gates beyond the auto speaker gate (GetCurrentTime, IsInInterior, GetActorValuePercent, a follower-faction gate, …)

scene.description: SCEN — NPCs talking to EACH OTHER (not the player), hosted by a quest, played as ordered phases. The participant NPCs must be PLACED near each other (a placements[] entry per NPC into the same cell) for the conversation to fire in-game.

questEditorId.description: host quest editorId (must exist in spec; StartGameEnabled so the scene runs)

beginOnQuestStart.description: auto-play the moment the host quest starts (the simplest 'two NPCs chat on load' trigger). Turn off to trigger from a script/package, or use autoStart for presence-gating

stopQuestOnEnd.description: stop the host quest when the scene finishes (vanilla one-shot conversation scenes set this with beginOnQuestStart)

autoStart.description: presence-gated auto-start (follower-banter style); when set the scene does NOT auto-play on quest start

actions.description: non-dialog beats (movement via a package / timed pauses) interleaved with the spoken phases

conditions.description: scene-level CTDA gate — the scene only STARTS if all pass. ONLY gates a beginOnQuestStart scene; for an autoStart scene use autoStart.gateGlobal (the controller forces Scene.Start(), bypassing scene begin-conditions)

sceneActor.description: One scene participant: an alias INDEX (unique in the host quest) + the NPC that fills it (UniqueActor-bound).

aliasId.description: alias index in the host quest (unique, >=0); the SceneActor references this

npc.description: ref → the NPC that fills this alias (in-spec editorId or <master>:0xFORMID)

name.description: optional alias name (defaults to the npc editorId)

scenePhase.description: One scene phase: actor `speaker` says `lines` with emotion; phases play in list order. A phase referenced only by an action may have empty lines (a pure beat).

speaker.description: the aliasId (from actors[]) who speaks this phase

lines.description: the spoken line(s) for this phase (played in sequence)

headtrackActor.description: actor aliasId to look at; -1 = look at no one; -2 (default) = the OTHER actor

headtrackPlayer.description: speaker headtracks the PLAYER (mutually exclusive with a non-default headtrackActor)

faceTarget.description: whether the FaceTarget flag is set (default true if unset)

startConditions.description: the phase only PLAYS if all pass (else the engine skips to the next phase)

completionConditions.description: the phase ENDS once all pass (a condition-driven advance beyond 'advance when the line finishes')

sceneAction.description: A non-dialog scene beat over a phase window. Set `idle` (PlayIdle via a phase fragment — may add `timerSeconds` as the pose-hold), `package` (a Package action), or `timerSeconds` > 0 (a Timer action). idle/package are mutually exclusive; package/timerSeconds are mutually exclusive.

actor.description: aliasId (from actors[]) that performs the action

idle.description: ref → an IDLE record; non-empty makes this a PlayIdle action: `actor` plays the idle when `startPhase` begins (via a SceneAdapter phase fragment + an auto-emitted Timer to run/hold the phase), then returns to AI. Only idles vanilla scripts actually PlayIdle work (bow/gesture/offset); furniture-gated kneel/pray idles do nothing

package.description: ref → a PACK (a packages[] editorId or <master>:0xFORMID) the actor runs across the phase window (Travel = walk to a marker; Sandbox = ambient activity)

timerSeconds.description: > 0 → a Timer action: the scene waits this many seconds over the phase window (no actor behaviour)

startPhase.description: first phase index (into phases[]) the action spans

endPhase.description: last phase index; -1 = same as startPhase

sceneAutoStart.description: Presence-gated auto-start tuning. The MFSceneBanterController polls and calls Scene.Start() when the player is within range of BOTH actors (+ optional LOS, not in combat, neither dead) and the cooldown has elapsed. Distances in game units, times in REAL seconds.

triggerDistance.description: max distance from the player to EACH actor

requireLineOfSight.description: also require the player HasLOS both actors

brawlOnEnd.description: the two actors fight each other (StartCombat both ways) the moment the dialogue finishes; mark the actors essential for a non-lethal brawl

playOnce.description: play at most once ever (the controller stops polling after the single play)

playHour.description: only play within ±playHourTolerance of this in-game hour (0..24, circular); -1 = any time

gateGlobal.description: ref → a GlobalVariable (GLOB) re-arm token: the scene plays only while it == 0; the controller SetValue(1) right after playing; some OTHER generated content SetValue(0) to re-enable it (build the GLOB in globals[])

projectile.description: PROJ — the bolt that flies from caster to target on an Aimed cast; carries its own model + flight physics + the explosion it triggers on impact.

flags.description: Projectile.Flag names: Explosion / Supersonic / Hitscan / MuzzleFlash / CanBeDisabled / PassThroughSmallTransparent / Rotation / … (default [Explosion])

model.description: .nif path — VERIFY against vanilla (a wrong path = an INVISIBLE bolt, no error)

explosion.description: EXPL ref — the boom on impact (in-spec editorId or <master>:0xFORMID)

musicTrack.description: MUST — an audio entry. SingleTrack plays `file`; Palette shuffles its sub-`tracks`; SilentTrack is a timed silence.

file.description: audio path under Data/Music (.xwm/.wav); a loose asset shipped via package --assets

music.description: MUSC — a music type the game selects by priority and assigns to cells[].music / worldspaces[].music.

priority.description: higher wins over lower-priority music at the same time

duckingDecibel.description: POSITIVE dB attenuation applied to other audio

hazard.description: HAZD — a radius effect that applies `spell` to actors in it every `targetInterval` seconds. Spawn it with a magicEffect archetype 'SpawnHazard' (+ association = this editorId) or place it (placements[].base = this editorId, or kind:'hazard').

model.description: .nif visual path (verify vs Skyrim.esm; empty = invisible)

lifetime.description: seconds (0 = inherit from spawn spell / permanent)

explosion.description: EXPL — the impact event a projectile/spell triggers: deals damage in radius, shows model + light, plays sound, swaps imageSpaceModifier, and can apply objectEffect (MGEF) to everything in radius (the AoE).

imageSpaceModifier.description: IMAD ref — screen post-process swapped on impact

objectEffect.description: MGEF ref — the in-radius AoE effect

flags.description: Explosion.Flag names: AlwaysUsesWorldOrientation / KnockDownAlways / IgnoreLosCheck / Chain / …

imageSpaceModifier.description: IMAD — a screen-space post-process applied/removed at runtime (brightness/tint), the way vanilla Night-Eye / cinematic flashes work. Referenced by explosion.imageSpaceModifier or a Papyrus ImageSpaceModifier property (a script applies it via ApplyCrossFade). A single static value (one keyframe per field).

tintAmount.description: tint strength 0..1 (mapped to the colour's alpha)

light.description: LIGT — a custom light source (colour / radius / fade / flicker). Minimal = just editorId (vanilla-sane omnidirectional). Place it via placements[] (base = this editorId).

name.description: in-game name (only shown for carriable lights like torches)

color.description: RGB tint (0..255 components; alpha unused). Default: warm white

radius.description: how far the light reaches (world units)

falloffExponent.description: how quickly brightness drops with distance

flags.description: Light.Flag names: Dynamic / Flicker / PortalStrict / CanBeCarried / SpotLight / ShadowSpotlight / OffByDefault / FlickerSlow / Pulse / PulseSlow / SpotShadow

identity.description: A lightweight identity/class the player can hold. `faction` is the persistent held-signal FACT (a bare in-spec editorId is auto-built, or an external <master>:0xID is used as-is). `priority` decides which identity wins as the primary greeting.

id.description: the tag used by identity/primaryIdentity dialogue gates

faction.description: the holding FACT — built if it's a bare in-spec editorId, else an external faction ref

priority.description: higher wins as the primary greeting identity

grants.description: SPELs/abilities added on join, removed on leave

grantPerks.description: PERKs added on join, removed on leave (e.g. a conditional smite-vs-undead perk); the acquire book grants the first, a default identity grants all

toggle.description: reading the acquire book again removes the identity

default.description: every player holds this from the start (baseline) — auto-granted by a StartGameEnabled quest (MFIdentityDefault)

activeWhen.description: situational CTDA that NARROW when the identity counts as active (e.g. WornHasKeyword/GetBaseActorValue/GetRelationshipRank/GetGlobalValue for reputation); each runs on the PLAYER unless it sets a non-default runOn

acquireBook.description: a BOOK whose OnRead grants/toggles this identity (MFIdentityBook)

acquireText.description: optional yes/no MessageBox prompt shown on read

onAcquire.description: optional performance played when the identity is acquired

scene.description: a scene editorId started on acquire

autoGrantWhen.description: auto-join this identity's faction once the player's ActorValue crosses a threshold (a poll controller reads GetActorValue; e.g. Dragonborn on DragonSouls>=1). Grants the faction signal only.

global.description: GLOB — a named number shared game-wide, save-persisted, readable by conditions (GetGlobalValue) + Papyrus + console. `value` is the INITIAL value only (an existing save keeps its own runtime value). Dialogue `setGlobal` can modify non-constant globals at runtime for flags/reputation counters.

type.description: Skyrim stores every global as a float on disk; short/long truncate to integer on read. 'int' is an alias for 'long'. Default short (the common flag/counter)

constant.description: Constant major flag — a read-only tuning value (can't be SetValue'd)

ambientColors.description: Six-direction hemisphere ambient light (DALC) — the flat fill that brightens a dark room overall.

lightingTemplate.description: LightingTemplate (LGTM): reusable interior lighting authored by copying a vanilla LGTM then overriding fields. All colour/float fields are optional (null = keep the template value).

template.description: optional vanilla LGTM to DeepCopy as base ('<master>:0xFORMID', e.g. Skyrim.esm:0x0300E2 = DefaultLightingTemplate)

lightFadeStart.description: distance at which lights start to fade

lightFadeEnd.description: distance at which lights fully fade

imageSpace.description: ImageSpace (IMGS): screen-space HDR / cinematic / tint base record attached to a CELL (distinct from IMAD which is a runtime modifier). Copy a vanilla IMGS via `template` then bump.

template.description: optional vanilla IMGS to DeepCopy as base ('<master>:0xFORMID')

eyeAdaptSpeed.description: HDR: how fast eye adapts to brightness changes

bloomThreshold.description: HDR: brightness threshold before bloom applies

white.description: HDR: white point (overexposure clamp); >1.0 makes it feel washed-out bright

cellLighting.description: Inline XCLL per-cell lighting overrides. Fields left null are inherited from the cell's lightingTemplate according to the `inherit` flags.

lightFadeBegin.description: distance at which lights start to fade (XCLL uses Begin/End, LGTM uses Start/End)

inherit.description: field-flag names still inherited from the lightingTemplate (template wins); a field both set inline and listed here is inherited + warned

referenceWav.description: path to a zero-shot reference clip (rel. to spec)

modelPath.description: optional: path to a fine-tuned model directory

rvcModel.description: optional: path to an RVC model for timbre stabilization

language.description: TTS language hint forwarded to the engine (engines that infer it from the reference ignore this)

exaggeration.description: engine-specific emotion scale; omitted = engine default (f5 ignores it)

speed.description: playback speed adjustment (e.g. 0.8 = slower); omitted = engine default

animationReplacer.description: OAR replacer-mod: root config {name,author,description} + named submods.

oarCondition.description: One OAR condition (OAR JSON shape, not Skyrim CTDA names). AND/OR nest children in conditions[]. Form refs: 'Plugin.esp|0xFormID'.

npcMoveset.description: Sugar: expands to the NPC-moveset condition recipe (IsEquippedType x2 + optional IsActorBase-not-player + IsRace + Random).

value.description: initial value; omitted in output for kEvent

name.description: macro name (the $ is added on emit)
